page.layout: One printed page: woodcut ornament band at head; then centred title block; then a dedication in verse with a large woodcut initial. Page number at top right. Signature at lower right of the text block.

main_text.head: GEORGII BVCHANANI SCOTI, Iambop liber.
D. GALTERO HADDONO MAGISTRO libellorum supplicium serenissimæ Angliæ Reginæ.

p.i: Vix me in Britannis montibus natum & solo
Nec Phyllidis me nunc iunat flauam comam

page.notes: The woodcut initial "E" is partly damaged; read as E. Some letters in the verse are faint (e.g. "langueat", "sparserit"); read as printed with possible uncertainty. Long s rendered as s throughout.
